build_EvalHook_non_distributed: build an EvalHook to periodically evaluate a model on a dataloader in a non-distributed training loop
build_DistEvalHook_distributed: build a DistEvalHook to periodically evaluate a model across multiple GPUs in a distributed training loop
test_EvalHook_save_best: test EvalHook with save_best set to auto to automatically track and save the best checkpoint by metric
refactor_EvalHook_custom_test_fn: refactor EvalHook to use a custom test_fn callable instead of the default single_gpu_test function
review_DistEvalHook_broadcast_bn: review DistEvalHook broadcast_bn_buffer logic that synchronizes BatchNorm running stats across ranks before evaluation
